chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from some of our companions, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): What is the definition of good character? He said: Soften your side, beautify your speech, and meet your brother with a pleasant countenance.
ai.seo_question: What is the definition of good character in Shia Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) defining *husn al-khuluq* not as abstract virtue but as tangible social ease: softening one's demeanor, speaking pleasantly, and greeting with a smile. This definition highlights the Shia emphasis on *sukhun* (warmth) and *tawadu* (humility) as essential components of spiritual refinement, making ethical conduct accessible in daily interactions. It reflects the Imams' teaching that good character is the primary means of attracting people to Islam and maintaining communal harmony.
